title: International Geomagnetic Reference Field
text: Calculate Earth magnetic field and secular variation using International Geomagnetic Reference Field, 4 inputs, 10 outputs, {Month} sets Input month; {Generation} sets the international Geomagnetic Reference Field generation, {Units}, {Input decimal year} sets the desired year, {Day} sets the input day, {Year} sets the input year, {Action for out-of-range input} sets the out-of-range block behavior and {Output secular variance} sets the secular variances. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: DXDYDZ
ports.summary: Secular variation of magnetic field vector

ports.name: DH
ports.summary: Secular variation of horizontal intensity scalar

ports.name: DF
ports.summary: Secular variation of total intensity scalar

params.name: Generation
params.values: International Geomagnetic Reference Field generation IGRF-14 (default) | IGRF-13 | IGRF-11 | IGRF-12

params.name: Month
params.values: Input month January (default) | February | March | April | May | June | July | August | September | October | November | December

params.name: Action for out-of-range input
params.values: Out-of-range block behavior None (default) | Warning | Error
